visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins outside 'Cat Cafe Mocha' in a brightly lit shopping mall. A large standing sign features a portrait of a woman with a cat on her head and the text 'Stop and let time slow down.' Potted plants and festive decorations are visible near the glass entrance where shoppers pass by. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of a laminated price menu held by a person. The menu is colorful and detailed, listing hourly rates, extensions, and drink options alongside small cat illustrations and QR codes. The background is a warm, softly lit cafe interior. (3) A series of quick cuts show various cats inside the cafe: a tricolor calico cat rests on a grey sofa while a hand gently touches its paw; a fluffy white and orange cat sits on a wooden ledge grooming itself; two large Maine Coon-style cats stand on their hind legs to reach a golden bird-cage perch. (4) The camera pans across the expansive interior featuring high ceilings, wooden floors, and bookshelves filled with manga. Several customers are seated on circular sofas or at tables, surrounded by cats. Red circular signage hangs from the ceiling above unique golden perches designed like cages. (5) A man with short black hair and glasses wearing a green vest appears in a handheld selfie shot. He smiles and points upward to a cat sitting on a golden perch directly above his head. He waves his hand at the camera as cats move around in the background.
